title: Rockefeller pressure leads the Clinton administration to look into Roswell

tellings.quote: according to Podesta, Clinton was not happy with the answers they were getting. They were getting the runaround.

plain: In the 1990s, the wealthy philanthropist Laurance Rockefeller pushed President Bill Clinton's White House to look into the Roswell case, a reported 1947 crash in New Mexico that many believe involved a UFO. The documentary filmmaker James Fox tells it, passing on what he heard from John Podesta, a senior Clinton aide, and pointing to a briefing paper Rockefeller prepared. According to Podesta, Clinton "was not happy with the answers they were getting. They were getting the runaround," which would mean even a president could not get straight answers about Roswell.
